svg.aria-label: Three frames split into independent blocks. Frame 0 and frame 2 go into PFOR blocks of 256 values, frame 1 into two byte lanes of PivCo blocks of 32 768 symbols. No block needs another, so all of them move to the GPU at once, one wave of 32 threads per PFOR block and four waves per PivCo block, and every block decodes in the same instant.
svg.text: 1 each frame is a run of independent blocks
2 no block needs another, so all go to the gpu together
3 every block decodes in the same instant, on its own waves
frames split into independent blocks that decode on many waves at once
gpu, one cell = one wave of 32 threads
pivco block, 32 768 symbols of a lane, 4 waves
